messages:
Elaine (Docs): Drafting a small "evidence export" section for SOC2/audit docs. Goal: show a minimal JSON schema, export examples (curl + Python SDK), and provenance fields auditors expect. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890 :eyes:
Sam (Security): Nice. Please include explicit wording about default retention and tenant overrides, plus a note about legal holds. Also call out that changing redaction rules can alter exported artifacts (provenance required).
Elaine (Docs): Proposed default sentence: "By default, Redwood retains audit evidence for 365 days. Customers may configure per-tenant retention where contractually permitted." (will add link to retention policy).
Nijah (Legal): Prefer: "By default, Redwood retains audit evidence for 365 days; customers may configure retention per tenant where permitted by contract. Evidence under legal hold is retained until release and is exempt from standard TTL deletion." Good to explicitly mention legal-hold exemption.
Matt (SDK): For the SDK snippet, clarify that the export produces newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) and include schema_version in each record. Older client versions may emit v1; include a small migration helper note.
Elaine (Docs): Schema example (for docs):
```json
{
  "evidence_id": "uuid-v4",
  "collected_at": "2026-03-10T11:02:03Z",
  "source": "audit_log",
  "tenant_id": "acct_ABC123",
  "events": 1024,
  "redacted": ["user_email", "ip"],
  "retention_days": 365,
  "legal_hold": false,
  "exported_by": "elaine.docs@redwood.ai",
  "export_timestamp": "2026-03-10T11:05:00Z",
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "provenance_hash": "sha256:..."
}
```
Sam (Security): That looks good. Add a short sentence explaining provenance_hash semantics: hash over canonical JSON of the original event + schema_version + export_timestamp.
Elaine (Docs): Adding that. Also adding a migration blurb: "Changing retention windows applies prospectively; existing archived evidence is not retroactively purged. When a legal hold is placed, affected records are preserved until the hold is released."
Kai (PM): Customers asked: if they reduce retention, do we provide a way to bulk-export before deletion? We should mention export and legal_hold APIs for retention migration.
Elaine (Docs): Good call. I'll reference the export API and show a curl + python usage.
Elaine (Docs): cURL example to request an export for a tenant between dates:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acct_ABC123&from=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z&to=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z" -o tenant_ABC123_export_20260301.jsonl
```
Elaine (Docs): Python SDK stream example:
```python
from redwood.audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
stream = client.export(tenant_id="acct_ABC123", from_ts="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", to_ts="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z")
for raw in stream:
    record = json.loads(raw)
    # record includes schema_version, exported_by, export_timestamp, provenance_hash
    store_locally(record)
```
Matt (SDK): I'll add a tiny helper in the SDK repo that normalizes v1->v2 fields and verifies provenance_hash; can link it from docs. I'll PR it today.
Elaine (Docs): One docs housekeeping item: found a broken anchor in docs/retention.md (anchor currently #default-ttl-days but our section uses #default-retention). deploy-bot, can we get a linkfix?
deploy-bot: Checklist: open tiny docs PR with linkfix, update changelog entry, include cross-link to SDK helper when available.
Sam (Security): Also request: add a short "audit integrity" note: auditors should be given the export bundle which includes a manifest file listing exported files, export_timestamp, exported_by, and a signed manifest_hash. We can recommend customers store exported bundles off-platform for long-term retention.
Elaine (Docs): I'll include a recommended manifest example and small note about storing exports in customer-managed storage for compliance.
Nijah (Legal): Approve the final phrasing for retention + legal_hold. One minor suggestion: replace "retain" with "retain and make available for export" in the first sentence to make obligations clear.
Elaine (Docs): Updated sentence to: "By default, Redwood retains and makes available audit evidence for export for 365 days; customers may configure per-tenant retention where permitted by contract. Evidence under legal hold is retained until release and is exempt from standard TTL deletion."
Kai (PM): Timeline: looks ready for the next docs deploy. Elaine, add a changelog line and mark PR ready. Matt will follow up with SDK helper link.
Elaine (Docs): Will do. Thanks all :clap:
